purpose: This table holds one row per scheduled commercial flight departing New York-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) during the profiled period, combining flight schedule and outcome fields with joined carrier, aircraft, and airport reference attributes.
usage: Consumers should read the table at the grain of one row per flight_date, carrier_code, and flight_number combination; delay, actual-time, and aircraft/destination-detail columns carry nontrivial null rates and must be handled as optional, and sign-bearing delay columns can be legitimately negative.
limitations: The declared grain is inferred from distinct-count arithmetic and a 0.0 duplicate_row_rate, not from a deterministic key constraint, and awaits warehouse-level grain measurement; aircraft and destination-detail columns have null rates near 16-18% and 2% respectively reflecting incomplete reference joins; captured_at is a pipeline-populated ingestion timestamp rather than flight-domain data and is retained as profiled.
